title: Jeff Merkley
intro:
Jeff Merkley (Democratic Party) is a member of the U.S. Senate from Oregon. He assumed office on January 3, 2009. His current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Merkley (Democratic Party, Working Families Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. Senate to represent Oregon. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
